description: Audits production scripts in folio-assistant/computations/ for the CAL-4-disguised-as-canonical pattern: a hardcoded numerical literal at module level combined with a 'substrate/canonical/derived' claim in the docstring, where neither the variable name nor the surrounding context tags the literal as validation/CODATA/acknowledged. Introduced 2026-05-22 after the LAMBDA_PROTON_DOC discovery in m_p_borromean_verification_50dps.py (see docs/canonical-derivation-cheat-sheet.md §5 fix #1).
